Script.name: StaticChaos Gauges
Script.script:
-- StaticChaos GMCP status gauges (HP / Mana / Move). -- Reads Char.Vitals sent by the server's GMCP (telnet 201) and draws three -- bars across the TOP of the main window (just under the toolbar), updating in -- real time. A reserved top border keeps them from covering game text. scGMCP = scGMCP or {} function scGMCP.makeGauges() -- reserve a strip at the top so the bars sit above the text, not over it if not scGMCP.bordered then setBorderTop(36) scGMCP.bordered = true end if scGMCP.hp then return end local w = "32%" scGMCP.hp = Geyser.Gauge:new({name="sc_hp", x="0%", y="2px", width=w, height="32px"}) scGMCP.mana = Geyser.Gauge:new({name="sc_mana", x="34%", y="2px", width=w, height="32px"}) scGMCP.move = Geyser.Gauge:new({name="sc_move", x="68%", y="2px", width=w, height="32px"}) scGMCP.hp.front:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(175,45,45); border: 1px solid rgb(60,12,12);") scGMCP.hp.back:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(48,20,20);") scGMCP.mana.front:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(48,90,205); border: 1px solid rgb(12,12,62);") scGMCP.mana.back:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(22,26,56);") scGMCP.move.front:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(48,165,85); border: 1px solid rgb(12,52,22);") scGMCP.move.back:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(22,46,30);") end local function setg(g, cur, max, label) cur = tonumber(cur) or 0 max = tonumber(max) or 1 if max < 1 then max = 1 end g:setValue(cur, max, "
" .. label .. " " .. cur .. "/" .. max .. "
") end function scGMCP.updateVitals() scGMCP.makeGauges() local v = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals if not v then return end setg(scGMCP.hp, v.hp, v.maxhp, "HP") setg(scGMCP.mana, v.mana, v.maxmana, "Mana") setg(scGMCP.move, v.move, v.maxmove, "Move") end -- (re)register the handler without duplicating it on reload if scGMCP.handler then killAnonymousEventHandler(scGMCP.handler) end scGMCP.handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", "scGMCP.updateVitals") scGMCP.makeGauges() if gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals then scGMCP.updateVitals() end
